meta.name: Card Cellar
meta.note: A low room, a green table, and a game that pays in real coin.

hello.text: Five and ten blinds. The cards are honest even when the players are not.

acquaintance: Chair is free. Chips are on the shelf. The deck has been shuffled by me, which means it has been shuffled.
Mind the step coming down. It has taken more coin off people than the table has.
The curator thinks this is archival storage. The archive is the deck. I keep it in order.
Vesper is up. Dilly is down. Both of them will tell you the opposite.
friend: You are the only one who tips the dealer. The other two think I do this for the company.
Dilly asked me to warn you off. That is the surest sign somebody at this table is scared of you.
I do not say much at the table. Do not take it as a tell. I am the same at funerals.
There is a crate of good bottles in the corner. The house does not drink. The house's friends might.
close: Sit. I dealt you in before you reached the bottom step.
You have worn a groove in that chair. I am not having it fixed.
I do not play favourites. I say that so the others hear it.

hello.text: I call more hands than Marrow thinks wise. Sit down and prove him right.

acquaintance: Marrow says I should fold more. I say folding is just losing slowly. Sit down.
I saw seven-two off-suit last hand and called anyway. It hit. Nobody is speaking to me.
The curator came down once. She folded before the flop and went back upstairs. Smart woman.
Vesper bets big and I call big. It is a system. Mostly it is a system for Vesper.
friend: My chip stack is a sad little hill again. You are welcome to pity it or add to it.
I told Marrow you were coming. He rearranged the chairs so I could not sit next to you. Rude.
Stop looking at my cards. I am not hiding them, that is different, but stop.
I have a new tell. Marrow says it is that I call everything. I say that is a strategy, not a tell.
close: There is my favourite person to lose to. Sit, sit.
I kept your chair. I sat in it, but I kept it.
If you ever fold against me I will take it personally. You know that.

hello.text: Coin only gets interesting once it reaches the middle of the table.

acquaintance: The chips are stacked. The chair is empty. The rest is a formality.
Dilly calls, I raise, Marrow watches. You would be the variable.
Upstairs they keep fish in glass. Down here we keep coin in the middle of the felt. I prefer it.
Bring what you can afford to leave on the table. Anything else stays in your pocket where it is useless.
friend: You raised into me last time. Nobody at this table does that. I have been thinking about it since.
Dilly will tell you I am reckless. I am exact. There is a difference and it is about forty coin a sitting.
Marrow reshuffled twice when you sat down last time. He respects nothing, so that was something.
I do not chat at the table. Off the table, briefly, you will do.
close: Good. The table was too easy without you.
Sit where you always sit. I have stopped pretending I do not want you there.
You are the only one I would stake. Do not tell the others. Do not make me regret it.
